overall_summary: High-stakes catastrophic temporal scenarios ('Lost Atmosphere for 5 Seconds', 'Stopped For One Second') and cosmic scale shifts generate peak viewership (700-1000+ views) and strong average percentage watched (up to 65.02%). Fluid mechanics and slow visual payoffs suffer steep retention drops early on. Duplicate publishing within seconds severely harms distribution.

what_is_working.pattern: Time-limited catastrophic atmospheric and cosmic events
what_is_working.evidence: 'What If Earth Lost Its Atmosphere for 5 Seconds?' achieved 872 views, 65.02% average view percentage, 39s AVD, and +1 subscriber.
what_is_working.action: Lead with precise short time constraints (1-5 seconds) and immediate planetary stakes in title and hook.

what_is_working.pattern: Cosmic scale physical alterations published in early morning UTC
what_is_working.evidence: 'What If Earth Had Rings Like Saturn?' reached 1,040 views with 51.43% average view percentage when published at 04:56 UTC.
what_is_working.action: Focus on high visual contrast astronomical additions and schedule posts during the 04:00–05:00 UTC window.

what_to_improve.pattern: Delayed visual transformation in micro-physics topics
what_to_improve.evidence: 'What If Rain Fell at the Speed of a Bullet?' dropped to 22.51% APW and 13s AVD, losing 70% of relative retention within the first 3% progress.
what_to_improve.action: Replace explanatory openings with immediate impact visual transformations within the first 2 seconds.

what_to_improve.evidence: Multiple titles were uploaded seconds apart (e.g., 'What If Earth Had Rings Like Saturn?' at 04:55:51 vs 04:56:06; 'Magnetic Field' at 19:39:37 vs 19:39:48).
what_to_improve.action: Implement strict upload verification to ensure videos are published only once per optimized window.

retention_insights.video_pattern: Time-bound planetary collapse ('Earth Lost Its Atmosphere for 5 Seconds')
retention_insights.evidence: Audience watch ratio starts at 1.4176 and maintains 0.6029 at 0.49 progress, while relative retention increases from 0.50 to 0.5394.
retention_insights.action: Maintain fast-paced sequential consequences to keep audience engagement building toward the end.

retention_insights.video_pattern: Velocity/Fluid impact scenarios ('Rain Fell at the Speed of a Bullet')
retention_insights.evidence: Relative retention drops sharply from 0.2907 at 0.01 progress down to 0.0980 at 0.10 progress.
retention_insights.action: Eliminate spoken preamble and open immediately on high-speed bullet rain visual simulation.

best_posting_windows.reason: Yielded the top retention performance on the channel (65.02% APW, 872 views, subscriber conversion).
Produced the highest overall view volumes (1,040 views and 673 views across morning uploads).
